title: Cyber Witch Cat
description: A stylized cat with a large glowing green eye containing a crescent moon sits upright, wearing a pink and yellow plaid sweater. It has a floating clock for a head with hands showing approximately 10:10, and holds a dripping crescent moon in one paw. A puddle below reflects its eye.
prompt: A surreal cyber witch cat with one giant glowing green eye containing a crescent moon, wearing a pink and yellow plaid sweater, a floating alarm clock for a head showing 10:10, holding a dripping neon crescent moon in its paw with green liquid, sitting above a reflective black puddle that mirrors its eye, vibrant psychedelic background with geometric patterns and symbols, glowing neon colors, digital fantasy art style
